name: Kerk en IT Parish
author: Kerk en IT

sections.description:
Enhance your parish website with a purpose-built WordPress plugin that makes it easy to share Mass times, manage parish information, and promote volunteer opportunities. Designed specifically for parish communities, it helps you better inform parishioners, welcome visitors, and strengthen your online presence.

Key features include:

  • A widget displaying your parish’s Mass times, also available as a shortcode.
  • An administration backend for entering all necessary data included in the widgets and shortcodes.
  • A shortcode for listing volunteer jobs.
sections.installation:
1. In WP Admin, go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “Kerk en IT Parish” and press Enter
  3. Click “Install Now”
  4. Click the “Activate Plugin” link
sections.faq:
Do I have to fill in duplicate data?

No, this plugin minimizes duplicate data entry. Everything is connected.

Why might this plugin not be suitable for our parish?

You may be expecting a feature that is not included yet. Please contact us to help us improve this plugin.
We are happy to consider your requests when they are a good fit for the plugin. We already have some ideas for improvements, but your feedback is always welcome.

Do you have a roadmap?

We have more improvements planned. Please send us your feedback if you have a feature request for this plugin.

Is data for your language missing?

Are you missing data for your language? Currently, this plugin works best in the Netherlands. We can add support for your language or country, but we need your help.

How can I contribute?

You can help us by providing data about your local dioceses.
We are also looking for translators. Please contact us, and we will work on adding support for your country.
